units.source_text: 但是，他并不是想要说谎。

en.t: But he had not meant to tell a lie.

units.source_text: 不管怎么说，这个女子总是个良家闺秀。

en.t: At any rate, this woman was still a well-bred girl from a good family.

units.source_text: 即使他想女人，也不至有求于这个女子。

en.t: Even if he wanted a woman, he would not go so far as to ask this woman for that.

units.source_text: 这种事，他满可以毫不作孽地轻易了结它。

en.t: He could easily have settled this sort of thing without feeling he had done anything wrong.

units.source_text: 初见之下，他就把这种事同她区分开来了。

en.t: From the first moment he saw her, he had kept that sort of thing separate from her.
